universal.description: Refresh and display the Optimaeus universal standards for this entity (hephaestus).
universal.prompt: Read /Users/octaviesmacpro/workspace/optimaeus/optimaeus-architecture/shared/UNIVERSAL-STANDARDS.md and summarize the standards that apply to the hephaestus entity right now: DB naming, LLM provider setup, port, shared packages, learning and skill table names, and inter-entity communication. Confirm which provider is currently reachable.

pkg-docs-check.description: Check official docs URL and current version for a package/library/framework before writing code. Use before any new import or install.
pkg-docs-check.prompt: Read .claude/skills/pkg-docs-check/SKILL.md for the full workflow, then .claude/skills/pkg-docs-check/url-registry.md for official URLs. Execute the pkg-docs-check workflow for:

hooks.command: bash -c 'path="${TOOL_INPUT_PATH:-}"; [[ "$path" == */human/* ]] && [[ -z "${HUMAN_OVERRIDE:-}" ]] && echo "BLOCKED: human/ is protected. Export HUMAN_OVERRIDE=1 to proceed." && exit 1 || exit 0'

bash -c '
set -e
cmd="${CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_COMMAND:-}"
if [ -z "$cmd" ]; then exit 0; fi
# Match destructive git commands from the CRITICAL BAN list in CLAUDE.md
if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE "(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_/-])(git[[:space:]]+(reset[[:space:]]+--hard|reset[[:space:]]+--hard[[:space:]]+HEAD|push[[:space:]]+(--force|--force-with-lease|-f)|rebase|checkout[[:space:]]+\.|restore[[:space:]]+\.|branch[[:space:]]+-D|clean[[:space:]]+-[fF]+[dD]?)([[:space:]]|$))"; then
  if [ -n "${DESTRUCTIVE_GIT_CONFIRMED:-}" ]; then
    exit 0
  fi
  repo_root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo "unknown")
  echo "BLOCKED: destructive git command detected."
  echo "  command: $cmd"
  echo "  repo:    $repo_root"
  echo "  reason:  Per CLAUDE.md, these commands require 3-step human confirmation."
  echo ""
  echo "If you have explicit user approval, export DESTRUCTIVE_GIT_CONFIRMED=1 and retry."
  echo "Otherwise, use a safer alternative (git stash, git revert, git reset --mixed, etc.)."
  exit 1
fi
# ABSOLUTE BAN: rm -rf, git clean, DROP TABLE, DELETE FROM no WHERE — always block
if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE "(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_/-])(rm[[:space:]]+-[rR][fF]|git[[:space:]]+clean|shred|dd[[:space:]]+if=/dev/zero|DROP[[:space:]]+TABLE|DELETE[[:space:]]+FROM[[:space:]]+[a-zA-Z_]+[[:space:]]*;|docker[[:space:]]+system[[:space:]]+prune)([[:space:]]|$)"; then
  echo "BLOCKED: absolute-ban command. Never run, no exceptions. See CLAUDE.md."
  echo "  command: $cmd"
  exit 1
fi
exit 0
'

echo '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "UserPromptSubmit", "additionalContext": "REPO GATE: Before reading any file or dispatching any agent, confirm the target repo with the user. Ask: Which repo is this task for? (full path) — CWD is not confirmation. Wait for explicit user confirmation before proceeding."}}'
